Survival analysis from excel sheet copied directly from Human Protein Atlas
```{r}
# TMEM165 and SLC35A2 survival data downloaded from Human Protein Atlas, for breast cancer (TCGA BRCA)
tmem <- read_excel("./Data/Breast TMEM165 Survival.xlsx")
slc <- read_excel("./Data/Breast SLC35A2 Survival.xlsx")

#description<-data.frame(do.call('rbind', strsplit(as.character(tmem$Description), ', ', fixed=TRUE)))
data_split <- slc %>%
  separate(Description, into = c("age", "gender", "ethnicity", "stage", "status", "days"), sep = ", ", fill = "left")
data_split <- data_split %>%
  mutate(event = if_else(status == "alive", 0, 1))
data_split$time <- as.numeric(gsub(" days","",data_split$days))/365
data_split <- data_split[order(data_split$TPM),]
colnames(data_split)[8] = "SLC35A2"
data_split$Sample <- gsub("-01A","",data_split$Sample)

tmem.cut <- surv_cutpoint(data_split, time = "time", event = "event",
   variables = c("TPM"))
summary(tmem.cut) # TMEM165: -0.0978, SLC35A2: 0.378
tmem.cat <- surv_categorize(tmem.cut)
head(tmem.cat)
colnames(tmem.cat)[3] <- "Tmem165"


tmem.fit <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~Tmem165, data = tmem.cat)
pvalue = surv_pvalue(tmem.fit)$pval.txt
ggsurvplot(tmem.fit, risk.table = TRUE, conf.int = F,pval=pvalue,ggtheme = theme_classic2(base_size=17))
```
2. Survival and expression analysis using full RNA-seq data downloaded from TCGA-BRCA
```{r}
queryt <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-BRCA",
                   data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
                   data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
                   workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
                   sample.type = "Primary Tumor")
queryc <- GDCquery(project = "TCGA-BRCA",
                   data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
                   data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
                   workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
                   sample.type = "Solid Tissue Normal")
```
```{r}
GDCdownload(queryt)
GDCdownload(queryc)
brca.exp <- GDCprepare(queryt, 
                       save = TRUE,
                       save.filename = "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/Spring_2025/TCGA BRCA Analysis/brca",
                       summarizedExperiment = TRUE)
norm.exp <- GDCprepare(queryc, 
                       save = TRUE, 
                       save.filename = "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/Spring_2025/TCGA BRCA Analysis/brca_norm",
                       summarizedExperiment = TRUE)
#Bind the Normal Samples and Tumor samples into one summarizedExperiment
#'pathology_report_uuid', 'days_to_sample_procurement', 'preservation_method' are unique, need to remove
colData(brca.exp) <- colData(brca.exp)[!(names(colData(brca.exp))) %in% c('pathology_report_uuid', 'days_to_sample_procurement',"figo_stage","figo_staging_edition_year")]
brca.exp = cbind(brca.exp,norm.exp)
def <- colData(brca.exp)$definition
def[def=="Primary solid Tumor"] <- "Primary"
def[def=="Solid Tissue Normal"] <- "Normal"
colData(brca.exp)$definition <- factor(def)
```
```{r}
# Get all the transcript_ids (Ensembl gene ID with version)
assay_data <- assay(brca.exp)
transcript_ids <- rownames(assay_data)
```

This plots expression level of Tmem165 or Slc35a2 in Tumor vs. Normal 
```{r}
brca.dds <- DESeqDataSet(brca.exp, design = ~definition) #56602 genes initially
keep <- rowSums(counts(brca.dds)) >= 10 # Keep genes with total counts >= 10
brca.dds <- brca.dds[keep,] # Keeping 48628 elements
brca.dds$definition <- relevel(brca.dds$definition, ref = "Normal")
brca.dds <- DESeq(brca.dds)
brca.vsd <- vst(brca.dds, blind=FALSE) # Generate normalized counts from raw counts
saveRDS(brca.vsd, "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/Spring_2025/TCGA BRCA Analysis/brca.rds")
brca.dds <- readRDS("~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/Spring_2025/TCGA BRCA Analysis/brca.rds")

# Plot TMEM165 or SLC35A2 expression
tmem165 <- assay(brca.dds)["ENSG00000134851.13",]
slc35a2 <- assay(brca.dds)["ENSG00000102100.16",]
dft <- data.frame("NormCount" = tmem165, "Definition" = brca.dds@colData$definition)
dfs <- data.frame("NormCount" = slc35a2, "Definition" = brca.dds@colData$definition)
ggboxplot(df,x="Definition",y="NormCount",color="Definition",add="jitter", add.params = list(size = 1, alpha = 0.5),order=c("Normal","Primary"))+ labs(y="SLC35A2")+
  theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5),axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=0.5,hjust=0.5),legend.position="none",axis.title.x = element_blank())
ggplot(df, aes(x = Definition, y = NormCount)) +
  labs(y="TMEM165")+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = factor(Definition)), width=0.3,size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = factor(Definition)), width = 0.8, alpha = 0)+
  stat_compare_means(method="t.test",label="p.format",hide.ns = T,comparisons = list(c(1,2)))+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5,size=13),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, vjust=0.5,hjust=0.5,size=13),
        legend.position="none",axis.title.x = element_blank())
```

Get the EnsemblIDs for a gene list, for calculation of gene list score 
```{r}
transcript_ids <- rownames(brca.dds)
# Get transcript names from list
human_glycan = read.csv("~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/Spring_2025/TCGA BRCA Analysis/Re_ Survival Plots/Human_Glycan_genes.csv",header=F)
human_glycan$ENSEMBL <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = as.character(human_glycan$V1), column = "ENSEMBL", keytype = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")
human_glycan_EnsemblIDs <- transcript_ids[grepl(paste(human_glycan$ENSEMBL, collapse = "|"), transcript_ids)] 

bt549_glycan = read.csv("~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/Spring_2025/TCGA BRCA Analysis/Re_ Survival Plots/BT549_sig_up_Glycan_genes.tsv",sep="\t")
bt549_glycan$ENSEMBL <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = as.character(bt549_glycan$x), column = "ENSEMBL", keytype = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")
pattern <- paste(bt549_glycan$ENSEMBL, collapse = "|")
bt549_glycan_EnsemblIDs <- transcript_ids[grepl(pattern, transcript_ids)] #ENSG00000102100.16

overlap_genes = c("PGM3","ST6GAL1","GOLGA2","EDEM3","GMPPB","SERP1","COG6","B4GALT1","EXTL3","ST3GAL2","TMEM165")
overlap_ensembl <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = as.character(overlap_genes), column = "ENSEMBL", keytype = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")
overlap_EnsemblIDs <- transcript_ids[grepl(paste(overlap_ensembl,collapse="|"), transcript_ids)]
# Get SIALYLTRANSFERASE genes 
human_gene_sets = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")
msigdbr_collections()
human_GO = human_gene_sets %>% dplyr::filter(gs_cat == "C5")
sialytransferase_table = human_GO %>% dplyr::filter(gs_name == "GOMF_SIALYLTRANSFERASE_ACTIVITY")
sialytransferase_genes = as.vector(sialytransferase_table$ensembl_gene)
sialytransferase_EnsemblIDs <- transcript_ids[grepl(paste(sialytransferase_genes,collapse="|"), transcript_ids)] # 21 Genes in GO term for Sialytransferase activity
```

Calculate and add gene list scores into metadata
```{r}
# Calculate gene set scores
bt549_set <- brca.vsd[bt549_glycan_EnsemblIDs,]
bt549_glycan_score <- colMeans(assay(bt549_set))
glycan_set <- brca.vsd[human_glycan_EnsemblIDs,]
glycan_score <- colMeans(assay(glycan_set))
overlap_score <- colMeans(assay(brca.vsd[overlap_EnsemblIDs,]))
sialytransferase_score <- colMeans(assay(brca.vsd[sialytransferase_EnsemblIDs,]))
colData(brca.vsd)$bt549_glycan_score <- bt549_glycan_score
colData(brca.vsd)$human_glycan_score <- glycan_score
colData(brca.vsd)$overlap_glycan_score <- overlap_score
colData(brca.vsd)$sialytransferase_score <- sialytransferase_score
```

```{r}
dft <- data.frame(Sample=colData(brca.dds)[c("sample_submitter_id")],"TMEM165" = tmem165,"SLC35A2"=slc35a2, "Definition" = brca.dds@colData$definition,"PAM50"=brca.dds@colData$PAM50)
```

Survival analysis using a gene list score 
```{r}
# Add glycosylation pathway scores to metadata of brca.dds or brca.vsd
tumor.vsd <- brca.vsd[,brca.vsd$definition=="Primary"]
# Calculate glycosylation pathway score and add to data.split
tumor_glyco_scores <- as.data.frame(colData(tumor.vsd)[c("sample_submitter_id","bt549_glycan_score","human_glycan_score","overlap_glycan_score","sialytransferase_score")])
# Add glyco_scores to data_split
data_merge <- merge(data_split,dft.PAM50, by.x="Sample",by.y="sample_submitter_id")
data_merge <- data_merge[!duplicated(data_merge$Sample),]
data_merge <- data_merge %>% 
  mutate(CTL_score=cut(CTL_score, breaks=c(0, median(data_merge$CTL_score), Inf), labels=c(" low", "high"))) # TMEM165: 55.7, SLC35A2: 52.7

# Calculate cutoff
glycan.cut <- surv_cutpoint(data_merge, time = "time", event = "event",
   variables = c("bt549_glycan_score","sialytransferase_score","overlap_glycan_score"))
summary(glycan.cut) # TMEM165: -0.0978, SLC35A2: 0.378
glycan.cat <- surv_categorize(glycan.cut)
head(glycan.cat)

glycan.fit <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~overlap_glycan_score, data = glycan.cat)
pvalue = surv_pvalue(glycan.fit)$pval.txt
ggsurvplot(glycan.fit, risk.table = TRUE, conf.int = F,xlim=c(0,11),pval=pvalue,ggtheme = theme_classic2(base_size=15))
```

```{r}
data_subtypes = merge(data_split,pam50[c("Complete TCGA ID", "PAM50 mRNA")], by.x="Sample",by.y="Complete TCGA ID")

subtypes = c("Basal-like","HER2-enriched","Luminal A","Luminal B")
plist <- list()
for(i in 1:4){
  sub = subtypes[i]
  print(sub)
  data_sub <- data_subtypes[data_subtypes$`PAM50 mRNA`==sub,]
  print(dim(data_sub))
  #data_sub <- data_sub %>% mutate(TMEM165=cut(TMEM165, breaks=c(0, median(data_sub$TMEM165), Inf), labels=c(" low", "high")))
  glycan.cut <- surv_cutpoint(data_sub, time = "time", event = "event",variables = c("SLC35A2"))
  summary(glycan.cut) # TMEM165: -0.0978, SLC35A2: 0.378
  glycan.cat <- surv_categorize(glycan.cut)
  head(glycan.cat)
  # Fit 
  glycan.fit <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~SLC35A2, data =glycan.cat)
  pvalue = surv_pvalue(glycan.fit)$pval.txt
  plist[[i]] <- ggsurvplot(glycan.fit, risk.table = TRUE, conf.int = F,xlim=c(0,11),pval=pvalue,ggtheme = theme_classic2(base_size=15))
}
```
